title: Bounded Task-Title Guard: Plan / Fix / Test / Review

task.title: Reject whitespace-only task titles without changing valid-title behavior
task.task_context: A local seed project accepts whitespace-only task titles. Scope the fix to the title normalizer, preserve valid titles, run the declared check, and send the patch plus test evidence to review.

task_state.evidence: created task, task graph, and run references persisted in the isolated .abproj workspace

artifacts.evidence: exported orchestration graph, fixture manifests, summaries, reports, and per-node bundles

recovery.evidence: a failed planning node is retried in a new completed run while the failed-run manifest remains preserved

claims.code_write_authority: declared and approval-gated; this fixture never performs a provider-backed write
